name: OP9
source: The story begins on June 25th, 1991. Play as Ami Madison, professional translator and new recruit in a secret organization known only as OP9 (short for Operation 9). When asked to leave your desk job and join six advanced recruits on a dangerous mission into the Soviet Union, will you accept?
